# Try clicking the top red entity to see what it does
# Top red is at (17,20)
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 17, 'col': 20}])
print("Click result:", result.get('board_changed'), result.get('gameplay_changed'))

# Check what changed - compare before/after
if previous_frame:
    before_seg = previous_frame.segmentation
    after_seg = current_frame.segmentation
    
    # Find 4px colored blocks in both
    before_blocks = {}
    for n in before_seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] == 4 and n['color'] not in ['B', 'c', 'G', 'N', 'R']:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
            center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
            before_blocks[(center_r, center_c)] = n['color']
    
    after_blocks = {}
    for n in after_seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] == 4 and n['color'] not in ['B', 'c', 'G', 'N', 'R']:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
            center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
            after_blocks[(center_r, center_c)] = n['color']
    
    # Find changes
    changes = []
    for pos in set(list(before_blocks.keys()) + list(after_blocks.keys())):
        bc = before_blocks.get(pos, '?')
        ac = after_blocks.get(pos, '?')
        if bc != ac:
            changes.append((pos, bc, ac))
    
    print(f"\nChanged blocks ({len(changes)}):")
    for pos, bc, ac in sorted(changes):
        print(f"  {pos}: {bc} -> {ac}")
else:
    print("No previous frame to compare")

</function>
